entities.name: D-alanine--D-alanine ligase
observations: The 366-aa query sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt entry Q10X06 from Trichodesmium erythraeum; identity and coverage are 100%.
Curated function is ATP-dependent ligation of two D-alanine molecules to form D-alanyl-D-alanine; EC 6.3.2.4 and Rhea RHEA:11224.
The enzyme binds two Mg2+ or Mn2+ ions per subunit and is annotated as cytosolic.
Pfam domains support D-alanine ligase architecture: Dala_Dala_lig_N residues 5-134, Dala_Dala_lig_C residues 153-358, and ATP-grasp residues 182-327.

entities.name: Peptidoglycan biosynthesis
observations: D-alanine--D-alanine ligase contributes to bacterial cell-wall formation by producing the D-alanyl-D-alanine dipeptide incorporated into peptidoglycan precursors.
The reference annotation assigns this enzyme to cell-wall biogenesis and peptidoglycan biosynthetic process GO:0009252.

entities.name: D-alanyl-D-alanine ligation
observations: Reaction: 2 D-alanine + ATP → D-alanyl-D-alanine + ADP + phosphate + H+; Rhea RHEA:11224.
The reaction is an ATP-dependent carboxylate ligation requiring divalent metal ions.

entities.name: D-Ala-D-Ala ligase sequence properties
observations: Query length is 366 amino acids; estimated molecular mass is 40,266.6 Da.
Theoretical pI is 5.20 and predicted charge at pH 7 is approximately -10.9; these are sequence-derived estimates.
